summary: Code review PASS. Implementation is clean, well-structured, and correctly implements all 5 acceptance criteria. resolveChangelogMeta() is a pure zero-import utility with correct line-priority logic and solid regex patterns. buildContext() unconditionally overrides version from changelog (correct per plan), and conditionally derives last_updated only when absent from all YAML sources. buildAgentNameMap() uses the same derivation pattern consistently. The changelog-version.test.ts test suite is thorough with 12 targeted tests covering all AC scenarios including multiline scalars, version-only format, explicit YAML precedence, fallback chains, and cross-suite agent_* display strings. Applied Fix-Forward: removed 3 stale inert `version:` fields from agent-name-map.test.ts fixtures (lines 394, 447, 497) that were never read by buildAgentNameMap() or buildContext() but could mislead future contributors. Updated one negative assertion from `not.toContain('Helper v2.0.0')` to `not.toContain('Helper v1.0.0')` to match the actual computed value. 483/483 tests pass post-fix. CHANGELOG.md entry and package.json minor bump (2.5.1 → 2.6.0) are correct and well-formed.

comments.note: tests/builders/agent-name-map.test.ts lines 394, 447, 497: Removed stale inert `version:` YAML fields from three test fixtures. These fields were never read by buildAgentNameMap() (confirmed: only slug, name, changelog are consumed) or by buildContext() (version is unconditionally overwritten from changelog/fallback chain). Removing them prevents future contributors from concluding that `version:` still drives agent display strings. Also updated one negative assertion from `not.toContain('Helper v2.0.0')` to `not.toContain('Helper v1.0.0')` to assert against the actual computed value (default_version: '1.0.0' from suite shared YAML). 483/483 tests pass post-fix.

[documentation-forward] api-surface.md and metadata-reference.md should note that the `version:` field in per-persona YAML is now inert — buildContext() unconditionally overwrites it with the changelog-derived value (or fallback chain). No test covers the case where both `changelog:` AND `version:` appear in the same persona YAML. Per the plan, `version:` is silently overwritten — the test suite implicitly covers this via the stale fixture tests that still had `version:` but passed. With those cleaned up, this edge case is purely implicit. Acceptable given the plan's explicit no-shim decision, but a single comment in the test file header noting this invariant would be useful.
